title: Equipment Rental Sign-In Log
subtitle: Capture asset number, component count, approved use, and condition photo; confirm custody and return.
description: Equipment Rental records asset number, component count, approved use, condition photo, custody, and return. Equipment Rental evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this equipment rental attendance and custody reconciliation when staff must document asset number and component count. Reconcile approved use, condition photo, custody, and return before the equipment rental handoff. Use the rental agreement reference, asset inventory, accessory checklist, condition photos, pickup receipt, custody transfer, damage ticket, return timestamp, and deposit disposition. This rental follows a portable asset by inventory class, serial identifier, accessory kit, pickup inspection, borrower custody, deposit disposition, damage charge, and physical return. Ask the assigned equipment rental reviewer to confirm asset number against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Equipment Rental details
sections.guidance: List asset and component count, approved use, pickup condition photographs, custodian, deposit reference, damage route, return time, and final condition.

sections.title: Equipment Rental renter identity, custody, and return
sections.guidance: Match the renter to the accepted reservation, issued access or item, starting condition, and completed return.

blocks.label: Equipment Rental roster boundary
blocks.guidance: Route any unmatched renter, access method, item, condition, or return before closing the custody log.

sections.title: Equipment Rental return outcome and custody reconciliation
sections.guidance: Reconcile issued access or items, returns, condition, and unresolved custody.

fields.label: Event coordinator or roster custodian and date
